zab bdun mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i mdos kyi 'gres bya ni/gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:brjid cing mdzes pa'i khri la bzhugs:zhal zas gtor ma'

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab bdun mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i mdos kyi 'gres bya ni/1$0000300 ❀ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: brjid cing mdzes pa'i khri la bzhugs: zhal zas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: rakta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: phyag mtshan lnga ni 'od du 'bar: rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas: bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon lnga: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas dang: sil snyan dril bu ting ting shag: rkang gling thod rnga dung gi sgra: mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: sra ba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan can: rta nag g.yag nag dar gyis brgyan: lug nag spyi dkar lcags rwa can: ra nag mchong gi rwa co can: khyi nag dung gi mche ba can: lcags kyi bya nag la sogs pa: srid pa'i gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa: snang srid mdos su byin brlabs pa'i: mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: chos dbyings sprin chen gdugs su phub: thabs shes rgyal mtshan 'phan dar phyar: srid pa'i 'byor tshogs ma lus pa: khams gsum mdos su byin brlabs te: mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul: ☺ snang srid mchod pa'i bye brag rnams: bdag gi lus dang longs spyod bcas: mchod rdzas mdos su byin brlabs te: mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol:

slob dpon thugs dkrugs dam 'gal bshags: byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: dbang bzhis rgyud smin grol ba dang: 'gro drug thugs rjes 'dzin pa dang: rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mchog: yun du gnas par mdzad du gsol:
༈ gzhal yas rim pa bzhi pa kai seng man la 'gres byang rtags mtshams man 'di ltar 'gres sgyur/

1$0000250☺ 1$0000300snang srid mchod pa'i bye brag rnams: mchod rdzas mdos su byin brlabs te: mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: gsang sngags dam las 'gal ba bshags: 'jig rten g.yo 'khrugs zlog tu gsol:
